assumptions.note: Illustrative durations for a fictional Corporate Affairs team, to be replaced by interview and timing data during pilots.

streams.name: Rapid Response
streams.trigger: A sensitive news item or stakeholder question needs a public position within hours

steps.pain: Alerts arrive by email and are missed outside office hours

future.change: Monitoring agent flags and summarises high-severity items

steps.step: Assess impact and find past positions
steps.pain: Past positions spread across SharePoint sites, emails and slide decks

future.change: Rapid Response agent (Copilot Studio) searches approved positions with sources

steps.pain: Each draft starts from a blank page

future.change: Agent drafts from approved language, writer edits

steps.pain: Sequential approvals by email, no status visibility

future.change: Power Automate parallel approvals with reminders and status

steps.pain: Briefing packs rebuilt and translated by hand per market

future.change: Briefing pack generated and translated, checked by market leads
Reaction dashboard fed from the data lake

streams.name: Policy Intelligence Reporting
streams.trigger: Weekly report on regulatory developments for each region

steps.pain: Copy and paste from many websites and newsletters

future.change: Feeds land in the data lake, deduplicated and checked
Policy Digest agent proposes tags, analyst confirms

steps.pain: Long summaries written from scratch every week

future.change: Draft digest with sources, analyst edits

steps.pain: Report waits in an inbox for review

future.change: Review task with deadline and reminder
Power Automate posts to Teams channels and email lists
